titleAr: ربط سيرفرك بالـ API بتوكن مخصص
titleEn: Call the API from your own server (integration tokens, scopes)
api: all GET routes scoped via ROUTE_SCOPES

en: Can I connect my own server to Ebda Chat?
Where do I get an API token?

steps: Token is issued by accounts.ebda.app with scopes conversations:read, messages:send, templates:read, contacts:read/write, campaigns:read
Poll /events with `after`; no websocket for tokens
edgeCases: Rate limits per API route class
gaps: No merchant screen in Chat to issue/revoke a token (issuance lives in accounts service; unverified where merchant does it)
Docs live only in site mdx
assistantNote: Assistant may explain and deep-link; issuing a token is a confirm action in accounts, not exposed from Chat
